'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025–2026 Kosovo political deadlock]]
**In [[Kosovo]], the [[Acting (law)|acting]] [[President of Kosovo|presidency]] of [[Albulena Haxhiu]] becomes ''[[de facto]]'' due to her having continuously served in the position for more than six months since assuming office on 4 April, violating the third paragraph of Article 90 in the [[Constitution of Kosovo|constitution]]. The [[Assembly of Kosovo|Kuvendi]] has two days left until the [[2026 Kosovan presidential election|presidential election]] deadline by the [[Constitutional Court of Kosovo|Constitutional Court]] expires. [https://www.kosovo-online.com/en/news/politics/jakaj-once-haxhius-term-acting-president-expires-without-agreement-it-will-be-unclear (''Kosovo Online'')] [https://rks.news/two-days-left-until-deadline-for-electing-kosovos-president/ (''RKS'')]
